Hymn 129: Where Can I Turn for Peace?
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: D Major
Composer: Joleen G. Meredith
Lyricist/Text Author: Emma Lou Thayne
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 129 titled "Where Can I Turn for Peace?" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in D Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Joleen G. Meredith and the lyrics were written by Emma Lou Thayne.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
